content.summary: Research findings for: staged/unstaged git change ingestion for a review UI in opencode

data.original_input: Explore feasibility for obtaining staged and unstaged git changes for the active folder/project and feeding them into a review UI.

codebase_findings.details: `File.status()` uses `git diff --numstat HEAD`, `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`, and deleted-file detection via `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=D HEAD`. `File.read()` checks git changes (`git diff <file>`, fallback `git diff --staged <file>`) and emits a structured patch via `structuredPatch`/`formatPatch`.

codebase_findings.topic: Session diff pipeline already used by UI
codebase_findings.details: Session summaries compute diffs from OpenCode snapshot commits (`Snapshot.diffFull`) and expose them via `/session/:sessionID/diff`. Data shape includes file path, before/after content, additions/deletions, and optional status. TUI sidebar consumes this as `session_diff`.

Server middleware resolves directory per request from `query.directory` or `x-opencode-directory`, else `process.cwd()`. `Instance.provide()` builds context from that directory and resolves git root (`worktree`) via `Project.fromDirectory()`. SDK clients can set a persistent directory header.

codebase_findings.topic: Current API coverage for review data
codebase_findings.details: Available APIs: file tree (`/file` -> `FileNode[]`), file status (`/file/status` -> `File[]`), file content+patch (`/file/content` -> `FileContent` with hunks), and session diffs (`/session/:id/diff` -> `FileDiff[]`). Missing API: explicit staged vs unstaged separation in one response.

codebase_findings.topic: Review UI diff rendering primitives already exist
codebase_findings.details: TUI already renders unified diffs with `<diff diff={...}>` for edit/apply_patch/permission flows. Web share UI parses unified patch text via `parsePatch` and renders side-by-side/mobile diff blocks.

Tool outputs are globally truncated (2000 lines / 50KB), but HTTP `file.read` is not truncated and currently computes full-context patch (`context: Infinity`) after loading whole file text (also `.trim()`s content). Binary/image handling exists in `File.read`; `Snapshot.diffFull` skips binary content when numstat reports `-`/`-`. `File.status` reads untracked file content to count lines, which is expensive for large files.

prior_art: No `learn-retrospective` packets found in `.agents/messages/` for this topic
patterns: Directory/workspace scope is request-scoped through `Instance.directory`; git root is tracked separately as `Instance.worktree`.
Existing review-like surfaces consume unified diff strings; they do not require custom binary patch formats.
Current git APIs are oriented to aggregate file change stats, not stage-aware review models.
Session-level diffs already use a rich file model (`before`/`after`), but based on OpenCode snapshots rather than git index/worktree state.
raw_options: Compose a review panel from existing `/file/status` + `/file/content` APIs and infer staged/unstaged heuristically client-side.
Add a dedicated git review endpoint returning `staged` and `unstaged` sections separately with unified diffs and parsed hunks.
Build a two-step endpoint: lightweight file list first, lazy per-file hunk fetch on expansion.
Reuse `Snapshot.FileDiff` shape for git-backed diffs and add `scope: staged|unstaged` field.
Keep using bash/git commands for review data (`git diff`, `git diff --cached`, `git status --porcelain`) and parse server-side into a stable DTO.
Prototype with staged/unstaged patch text only, postpone per-line metadata computation to UI parser.
Add binary/file-size guardrails before diff hydration to prevent oversized responses.
Support subdirectory-scoped reviews by defaulting to `Instance.directory`, with optional repo-root mode based on `Instance.worktree`.
